paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
Ong astu, ingketah, apasawanara, pakandirdora, bapakanswa, donnyapaya, wingkitah pakandirdora, madyingtis, ampu
wandwarosandora, yarakawantiktis, toh mantra hindra, pasawantih, madyintispakandir, panes mwa
ktwa, widuyandoswantihdosandwa, tambati priprityandi, paneswyattwa, yandolangrudra
randwadosawanra, matyandwih, tambatilatwa, rihandandwa priyayungsawanantra, wingtwapaneswyattwa.
paleography.indonesian_translation: Semoga ada keselamatan. Catatan mengenai penawar penyakit sawan dan khasiat tanaman, kulit kayu dan dedaunan yang memiliki khasiat obat dengan sifat madya dan tis (dingin), serta penawar untuk kondisi panas dan pengaruh buruk.
paleography.english_translation: May there be success and well-being. Notes regarding remedies for convulsive ailments (sawan) and plant efficacies, bark and leaves possessing medicinal properties with moderate and cooling natures, as well as antidotes for feverish/hot conditions and afflictions.

ethnomedicinal_entity.preparation_instructions: Teks memuat catatan pengobatan dan penawar sawan (upas/sawan) dengan karakter sifat tis (dingin) dan panes (hangat), namun nama spesifik tanaman dan petunjuk ramuan medis lengkap tidak dapat diidentifikasi secara pasti.

paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
1. Ong awighnam astu. Hring Sang Hyang Bhagawan Taru, mawyaktining herot rawuh pahing sarwwa taru, ngahêrot rawuh maring Sang Hyang, herot maring Sang Hyang, pahing malih, tityang taru, paswaran tityang, ngerot rawuh,
2. yan tityang Taru Sotong, tityang panes, don tityang hidep, dados tamba loloh, tamba sangkêt, twa tamba ring, panes mletu, langkung malih, maduluran tamba loloh, ngerot rawuh, pahing Pule, panes mletu langkung,
3. yan tityang Taru Kalyasem, mawit tityang mrot sarwwa rawuh, sarwwa kadengkul, tityang patut swaran tityang, babakan tityang malih rawuh hidep, hyang tityang panes mletu langkung.
paleography.indonesian_translation: Semoga tiada rintangan. Kepada Sang Hyang Bhagawan Taru, tatkala menghadap semua tumbuhan datang mempersembahkan khasiatnya kepada Sang Hyang. Bersabdalah Taru Sotong: hamba berkhasiat hangat/panas, daun hamba dapat dijadikan obat loloh (minum) untuk meredakan demam panas bergejolak. Demikian pula Taru Pule, berkhasiat hangat/panas. Selanjutnya Taru Kalyasem (Kaliasem), kulit kayunya (babakan) berkhasiat hangat/panas untuk pengobatan.
paleography.english_translation: May there be no obstacles. Before the divine Bhagawan Taru, all medicinal plants present their virtues. Taru Sotong declares: my energy is warm/hot, my leaves can be prepared as a loloh drink to relieve internal heat/fever. Likewise Taru Pule has a warm energy. Furthermore, Taru Kalyasem (Kaliasem) provides its bark (babakan) which has a warm energy.

ethnomedicinal_entity.preparation_instructions: Daun Taru Sotong dijadikan sarana obat loloh (minum) untuk meredakan panas.

scientific_validation.modern_pharmacological_action: Antimikroba terhadap Escherichia coli dan antispasmodik untuk meredakan kontraksi usus.
reference_studies: Uji antimikroba ekstrak daun jambu biji

waringin, rasan tityang pahit, don tityang, boreh, loloh, sampun
yata, pule, maweh, vyadhi tiwang, babakan tityang, boreh, adas pulosari
patiwit, taru sotong, rasan tityang, panes, don tityang loloh, padem
paleography.indonesian_translation:
Sang pule bersabda, "Hamba adalah pohon pule (taru pule), khasiatnya panas dumelada. Khasiat kulit batang hamba untuk mengobati panas tis (demam), dapat dicampur kulit kaliasem dan babakan jambu klutuk (sotong) sebagai loloh.

Adapun pohon sotong rasanya panas, daunnya diolah menjadi loloh/boreh untuk meredakan penyakit.
paleography.english_translation:
The tree Pule spoke, "I am the pule tree, my nature is warm-moderate (panes dumelada). My bark is for treating fever/chills (panes tis), combined with the bark of kaliasem and guava (sotong) as a tonic (loloh).

Likewise, the sotong (guava) tree has a warm property, and its leaves are processed into herbal drink/application to relieve ailments.

ethnomedicinal_entity.preparation_instructions: Babakan taru pule dipadukan bersama babakan kaliasem dan babakan sotong, diolah menjadi ramuan loloh.
